subject: Update
text: Replying to your last message. Project updates. Hall list done. Sign-up sheet works. One helper dropped out. I have a conflict. Shelter needs me Sunday evening. I can do Saturday instead. Bring flyers. We can finish early. Table cloth needs washing. Kettle is fine. First-aid kit has tape. Name tags are in a bag. Raffle tickets arrived late. Numbers are small. We can still sort them. Bring a pen. Bring a marker. If rain, we move inside. Side door unlocks with code. You know the code. I will text you at noon. Unless service fails. Do not wait at gate. I may be late. Sorry again. Committee asked for photos. Take them quickly. Do not film faces. We should stay focused. It will be okay. Call only if urgent. I will manage both. Thanks.
